dedupe_keys.name: nanjing uav to ground channel impulse responses across three settings

description: This collection contains measured air-to-ground channel impulse responses from a sports field, farmland and an over-water setting in Nanjing, China. The university channel-sounding team records a 3.6-gigahertz link with 61.44-megahertz bandwidth at UAV altitudes of ten and fifteen metres. Each response snapshot has two hundred channel samples and accompanying positioning and elapsed-time fields. Mendeley version 2 lists thirty-eight Excel, MATLAB and documentation files, free under CC BY 4.0, including derived delay profiles, path loss and delay-spread measures. The article calls the raw tables XLS, while the current inventory lists XLSX. Exact collection dates are not established. Coverage is limited to the selected settings and flight heights, which restricts extrapolation to dense urban or high-altitude links. A reviewer-assessed use is calibrating height-dependent propagation components in UAV communications simulations. platform-ns-3 is a related network environment, without tested compatibility. No measurements or processing code were executed.
